hotels.title: Maldives All-Inclusive Luxury with Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks and Six Onsite Bars and Restaurants
hotels.description: Escape to an exceptional island sanctuary at this highly acclaimed Maldives resort nestled in the Indian Ocean. Lily Beach Resort and Spa delivers unmatched all-inclusive luxury, from free-flow drinks and gourmet dining to island adventures and five-star facilities. Indulge at the onsite restaurants, including the sand-lined main dining room Lily Maa and trendy beach bars. Enjoy free-flow drinks and sip on a selection of imported Taittinger champagne or 80 premium wines from around the world, all while savouring spectacular gourmet cuisine. Beyond drinks and dining, days here take their own natural rhythm. Guests can drift between the pools, wade into the clear lagoon or snorkel among the reef's marine life. For something quieter, the resort offers yoga sessions and a full spa menu at Tamara Spa - a worthwhile counterpoint to the more active pursuits on offer.

hotels.title: Maldives #1 Resort: All-Inclusive Luxury with Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks & Roundtrip Malé Transfers
hotels.description: Escape to an exceptional island paradise at this highly acclaimed Maldives resort, where you'll experience unmatched all-inclusive luxury. This exceptional escape offers a uniquely unparalleled experience and has been honoured as the Maldives' Leading All-Inclusive Resort 2024 by the World Travel Awards. Indulge at the onsite restaurants, including the sand-lined main dining room Lily Maa and trendy beach bars. Enjoy free-flow drinks and sip on a selection of imported Taittinger champagne or 80 premium wines from around the world, all while savouring spectacular gourmet cuisine. Plus, one child stays for free, making it a perfect choice for families. Transform your stay into a luxe playground in paradise and be spoiled by endless ways to fill your day. Stretch out alongside one of the shimmering pools, dip your toes in the translucent lagoon or explore an underwater world teeming with marine life. Find tranquillity with a peaceful yoga class or revitalise with a lavish treatment at the Tamara Spa.
